description: One preflop starting-range chart for one table size, position, decision context and stack depth, transcribed from a single licence-verified source. Hand keys are canonical representative combos (see README.md in this directory); values map actions to frequencies in [0, 1]. Importers must additionally enforce: card distinctness, non-increasing rank order, canonical suit labelling, per-context action sets, and per-hand frequencies summing to 1 (within rounding tolerance).

context.description: rfi = first-in decision; vs_rfi = facing a single open raise (the three_bet action lives here); three_bet = facing a three-bet; sb_play = small-blind first-in/completion decisions.

context_detail.description: Optional specifics the enum cannot carry, e.g. the opener's position for vs_rfi or the three-bettor's position for three_bet, exactly as stated by the source.

id.description: Stable slug identifying this range set, e.g. publisher-context-position-stack.

rake_note.description: Rake structure assumption stated by the source, or an explicit note that the source does not state one.

licence.description: Licence / terms basis under which the data may be stored and used in this personal tool, as verified by the coordinator before the entry is added.

stack_bb.description: Effective stack depth in big blinds the chart was computed/published for.

title: PLO4 preflop range set
